Subject: Invoice INV-2029-118 — payment routing, W-9 and virtual-card option

Hi Sara,

Please find attached invoice INV-2029-118 for the March usage period (PDF attached). We can accept payment via ACH, wire, or virtual card. Attached also is our W-9 and a one-page wire instructions document — happy to provide any additional tax residency / VAT paperwork if you need it.

If virtual card is easiest for your AP team, we can accept it but note a 2% processing convenience fee applies on our side for card settlement. We can either:
- Accept the card and absorb the fee (we would request a 1-day extension to give ops time to reconcile), or
- Apply a 2% fee line item on the invoice (your preference).

Quick asks: can you confirm preferred payment rail (ACH / wire / card) and expected payment date? If ACH/wire, please confirm net terms and final remittance email so we can mark the invoice for release.

Attachments: INV-2029-118.pdf

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes

Hi Rafael,

Thanks — received the invoice. A couple of things from our side:
1) We need a completed vendor onboarding form and a current W-9 before we can schedule payment. I attached our onboarding form (Celestia_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf).
2) Our default is to pay via virtual card; we can process on 2029-04-18 if you accept card and confirm whether Redwood will absorb the 2% convenience fee or expect it to be passed through. If you need an extension for reconciliation, we can bump to 2029-04-20.
3) Also confirm whether Redwood can provide a US tax ID for remittance records (TIN on the W-9 is fine).

If you can upload the completed onboarding + W-9 to our vendor portal (link below) that will speed things up.

Portal: https://vendor.celestiahealth.example/onboard

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Manager, Accounts Payable

Sara — thanks for the quick reply and the onboarding form. I completed the W-9 (attached) and scanned the vendor form you sent (attached as requested). Our TIN is on the W-9 file (W9-Redwood-Inference.pdf).

We are fine to accept the virtual card and do not need the fee passed back to you; Redwood can absorb the 2% convenience fee for this one-off. If you prefer, we can also accept ACH/wire and you can keep the invoice amount as-is. Wire details are attached (Redwood_Wire_Instructions.pdf).

I submitted the vendor form to the portal link you provided and included the DocuSign PO link below for quick acceptance of the small amendment clarifying payment method (optional). If you schedule card settlement, please send the remittance and transaction id so ops can match the payment.

DocuSign PO (optional): https://docusign.example/release/ABC123

Attachments: W9-Redwood-Inference.pdf, Redwood_Wire_Instructions.pdf

Appreciate it — let me know if you need anything else to unblock.

Best,
Rafael
